native_comparison.limitations: Source crops are selected presentation regions, not proof of unchanged pixels or botanical/architectural accuracy. The first two frames come from actual context-road geometry and its retained campus seam; their footprints are diagnostic framing, not surveyed road bounds or new places. Original source-tree name/prototype allocation can differ across native processes; separate native preservation records apply. Metadata inputs are historical file fingerprints, not recursively embedded metadata or active temporary artifacts. Native protection and human visual inspection are separate gates. No reference parity is claimed.
